newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cypress Semiconductor raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cypress Semiconductor raised.

text.p: --Robertson Stephens analyst Dan Niles raised his recommendation on Cypress Semiconductor Corp to buy from long-term attractive and added the firm to the focus list.
--raised fourth quarter revenue estimates to $117 million from his previous estimate of $114 million.
--raised fiscal 1997 earnings per share estimates to $0.45 from $0.38 and set a $20 per share price target for the next six to 12 months.
--Shares of Cypress were up one at 14-7/8 in midday trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
